device.description: 16-bit 500 kSPS bipolar differential-input micropower SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and daisy-chain
device.note: ads8318.pdf (SLAS568A) p.3 specifications (tCONV 1400 ns max), p.4 power supply (+VBD 2.375-5.5 V) and logic levels, p.5-6 timing requirements, p.7 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.13-14 3-wire CS mode without busy indicator (Figure 46), p.22 digital output code table (twos complement codes: 0 V = 0000h)

pages: p.3 (conversion time), p.4 (supplies, logic levels), p.5-6 (timing), p.7 (pins), p.13-14 (3-wire CS mode, Figure 46), p.22 (output codes)
notModeled: analog input and reference (bipolar differential +-Vref: the 0 V code is 0000h; the datasheet headlines the table 'straight binary' but its codes are twos complement)
mode selection by the SDI level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without busy indicator (SDI tied high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; SDI is not read
4-wire CS mode (SDI as CS), busy-indicator bit (CONVST or SDI low at the end of conversion) and daisy-chain mode (SDI as chain input)
SDO driven while CONVST is low during a conversion (modeled: the frame shows the last result); the datasheet requires CONVST high again before the minimum conversion time
auto power-down after each conversion (no visible bus effect); acquisition time and throughput limits
timing values are the +VBD < 3.1 V (ADS8318) / < 4.5 V (ADS8319) table (ten 22 ns, t3 24 ns, tdis 15 ns); at higher +VBD they are 15/16/12 ns
variants: ADS8318I and ADS8318IB are accuracy grades of the same device; ADS8319 is the unipolar sibling (own datasheet)
